Thanks for sending. Confirming the redlines are Silverline’s formal positions: we need the liability cap removed and replaced with a $10M cap or 5x annual fees (whichever is greater), the indemnity to cover third-party IP claims broadly (no knowledge/time-based carveouts), and a 90-day warranty tied to performance SLAs rather than a 30-day defects-only warranty.

Vivek / Marissa — forwarding Silverline’s reply. Short recommendation from legal & deals:

- Liability cap: counter to a fixed $1M cap OR 2x annual committed fees (whichever is higher); we should not accept $10M or removal of cap.
- Indemnity: accept limited IP indemnity as drafted but push back on unlimited third-party indemnities and retain knowledge/time carveouts for any newly discovered infringing models. Add an explicit exclusion for indirect/consequential damages.
- Warranty: agree to extend warranty language to 90 days but tied to specified SLA KPIs and with remedy caps aligned to the liability cap.
- Commercial discount: recommend approving up to 30% first-year (on approval path) but anything beyond 30% needs VP or CRO sign-off given precedent.

These items are material; I recommend escalation to the COO for executive sign-off on the liability cap and the 30%+ discount request. Marissa, can you greenlight an escalation memo to the COO and include the redlined PDF? Vivek, draft the customer-facing concession email once we have exec direction.

—Laura
